summary: Keep golang.org/x/net at or above v0.60.0 so the reachable HTTP/2 HPACK race stays fixed.
reason: v0.57.0 is reached from cli.Execute and main through x/net/http2 and fails govulncheck on GO-2026-6617. Reprints must not regress below v0.60.0, and a go.mod edit must keep the go directive on the catalog floor (1.26.9), which carries the standard-library half of the same advisory.
validated_outcome: govulncheck ./... with go1.26.9 reports no vulnerabilities.
